App.name: AI Sims
App.description: Design a photoreal 3D character, then talk to it in Turkish or English.

Session.notConfigured: Database not configured: set MONGODB_URI, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and BETTER_AUTH_URL in web/.env.local.

story.label: From character to voice: how AI Sims works

idea.title: Create your character. Then talk to it.
idea.body: Design a photoreal digital human. When you are done, it talks with you out loud.

voice.title: First, give it a voice.
voice.body: The AI writes the reply; the voice reads it in Turkish or English.

viseme.title: Every sound is a mouth shape.
viseme.body: Speech splits into 15 visemes, and each one plays at the right moment.

lips.title: The lips say the word.
lips.body: Sound and mouth come from the same timeline. Closures start a few milliseconds before the sound.

start.title: Now it is your character's turn.
start.body: Build your character in a minute, then ask it “how are you?”

Characters.title: My characters
Characters.lede: Characters you have saved. Open one to edit it or talk to it.

empty.title: The stage is still empty.
empty.body: Create your first character: pick a face, hair and clothes, then talk to it.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.body: The character and its thumbnail are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

Characters.deleteFailed: Could not delete. Check your connection and try again.

Creator.title: Character creator
Creator.nameRequired: Give your character a name first.

identity.baseHint: Changing the base re-picks face, hair and clothes from what fits that base.
identity.voiceHint: The voice used when it talks. The language follows the site language.

face.blendHint: Mix in features from other faces. Each slider sets how far the face leans towards that one.
face.pickBlend: Pick a face to blend towards
face.blendFull: Up to three faces can be blended; remove one to add another.

body.unavailable: The body sliders for this base have not been exported yet.
body.slidersHint: Start from the chosen type and tune each measure on its own.

skin.makeupHint: Uses this skin set's made-up face texture.
skin.makeupUnavailable: This skin set has no makeup.
skin.setsHint: Real skin textures, shown as they look under the stage light.

eyes.tintHint: Recolours the iris and keeps its natural detail.

hair.patternHint: A pattern adds a second colour over the dye or natural colour.

facialHair.sharedColor: Brows, beard and moustache use the hair colour.

outfit.fullReplaces: A one-piece outfit replaces the top and bottom.
outfit.empty: No clothes in this section for this base.
outfit.comingSoon: The wardrobe is on its way.
outfit.comingSoonBody: Clothes appear here once they are exported into the library. Until then the character wears the MetaHuman base outfit.
outfit.colorsHint: Paint this part of the garment any colour.

socks.title: Socks
socks.hint: Shown on bare feet and above the shoes; trousers cover them.
socks.nudeHint: Nude tights take on the skin tone.

jewelry.hint: One piece per spot; picking another swaps it.
jewelry.limit: Up to {max} pieces can be worn.

tattoos.empty: No tattoos yet. Pick a small design and where it goes.
tattoos.taken: There is already a tattoo there.

autosave.needsName: Kept in this tab. Name it to save the draft.
autosave.error: Could not save the draft. Will retry.

Creator.saveFailed: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.

hints.auto: Adjusts itself to the frame rate

manifest.missingTitle: The MetaHuman library is not on this machine.
manifest.missingBody: The creator opens once the exported assets are copied to web/public/assets/mh/.
manifest.errorTitle: The parts list could not be loaded.

Talk.dragHint: Drag to turn, scroll to zoom

chat.title: Chat
chat.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.

empty.title: {name} is listening.
empty.body: Ask anything, or try one of these.

suggestions: Tell me a bit about yourself.
chat.hintBusy: Press Esc to stop the reply.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again from the home page.
errors.notConfigured: No AI provider is configured. Add a provider key to web/.env.local.
errors.rateLimited: You've reached today's message limit. You can talk again tomorrow.
errors.unavailable: The services are busy or rate-limited right now. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.invalid: This message could not be sent. Shorten it a little and try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.interrupted: The reply was cut off. You can ask again.

voice.notConfigured: Voice is not configured; replies will arrive as text.
voice.rateLimited: Today's voice limit is used up; replies will arrive as text.
voice.unavailable: The voice could not be generated; the reply arrived as text.
voice.failed: A sentence could not be spoken.

Talk.manifestMissing: The MetaHuman library is not on this machine; chat still works.
Talk.manifestError: The parts list could not be loaded; the chat still works.

Curate.title: Curation
Curate.lede: Choose what the creator offers. Hidden items stay in the export but never reach the people making characters.

auto.notice: {count, plural, one {# very similar item was} other {# very similar items were}} hidden in the pre-pass.
auto.restored: {count, plural, one {# of them is kept again} other {# of them are kept again}}

selection.label: Selection
selection.shortcuts: H hides, K keeps, Esc clears

status.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}

Curate.saved: Curation saved. The creator uses it the next time it loads.

Curate.loadFailed: The current curation could not be read, so nothing is hidden yet.

empty.body: Run the export for this category, then reload the page.
empty.outfitsBody: They will appear here as soon as the pipeline delivers them.

preview.keyboard: ← → to browse, H hides, K keeps
